proposal:
# Card 228 mid-card decision: fixing the pre-ship gate's HOLD

The pre-ship gate (be1bc1a) says HOLD. Blocking finding: red 3a pins `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"` as allowed by the hook (tests/test_delete_guard_hook_3a.py:147) and green 3a lets it through (delete_guard.py:1129, applied at 1146-1147), against the architect's ruling (ruling-sshagent-architect.md: a recorded finding, fail closed, no clean twin). The reviewer showed a bypass: a shell function or PATH shadow named ssh-agent that echoes `rm -rf ~`, then `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"`, exits 0. Second finding (not blocking alone): locate_copilot accepts a session.start up to 10 s after launch, but 20 of 20 real sessions started 13 to 24 s after the recorded launch, so a live Copilot seat would always report "no command source" and criterion 2's live-Copilot claim is unproved. Criterion 3 is capped at two cycles, so any fix needs this window.

Options:
(a) One fix cycle: a red flips line 147 so the hook refuses `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"` (the ruling), pins the shadowed-ssh-agent bypass as refused, and pins a Copilot session starting 13 to 24 s after launch as found (with a bound, say 60 s, and two matches still "no command source"); a green removes the allow and widens the tolerance. Then the gate re-checks only these.
(b) Ratify the allow: the architect changes the ruling for the hook and the bypass is recorded as a known limit; the tolerance goes to a follow-up.
(c) Split: ship with both as follow-up cards.

Proposal: option (a). Reason: the card's safety purpose is that a flagged command is blocked, and the reviewer demonstrated a working bypass of exactly that; the locator change is one constant plus a test, with real start offsets already measured.

Ask: NO OBJECTION, or OBJECTION with one fixed condition.
